title: Create Head Static Assets and Update Document Head Links
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1.1: og-image.png is valid 1200x630 PNG under 250 KB with NEETFORGE branding
AC-1.2: favicon.svg is valid scalable SVG vector graphic
AC-1.3: apple-touch-icon.png is crisp 180x180 square PNG
AC-1.4: manifest.json contains valid PWA manifest fields and links to icons
AC-1.5: index.html correctly references apple-touch-icon, favicon.svg, and manifest.json
description: Generate and place authentic binary and vector static assets in the public directory to eliminate HTML-fallback 404 responses for social media crawlers and mobile browsers. Update index.html head tags to correctly bind apple-touch-icon.

title: Validate Static Asset MIME Types, Dimensions, and Response Codes
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1.1: Image resolution 1200x630 confirmed; MIME type image/png
AC-1.2: SVG valid XML structure; MIME type image/svg+xml
AC-1.3: Apple touch icon resolution 180x180; MIME type image/png
AC-1.4: manifest.json passes JSON lint and PWA audit
AC-1.5: Zero responses contain <!doctype html> fallback
description: Execute automated assertions inspecting HTTP response headers, MIME types, image dimensions, and JSON schema parsing to verify no soft 404 fallbacks occur on asset URLs.

title: Configure Vercel HTTP Security Headers and 1-Year Immutable Asset Caching
acceptanceCriteria: AC-2.1: Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable configured for /assets/(.*)
AC-2.2: Strict security headers (nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS preload) applied to all routes
AC-2.3: SPA rewrite scoped to prevent soft-404 masking on missing static assets
description: Update vercel.json with production edge headers for 1-year immutable caching on content-hashed Vite assets, enterprise HTTP security headers, and rewrite boundaries isolating client-side SPA routing.

title: Verify Edge Headers, Cache-Control Directives, and 404 Error Codes
acceptanceCriteria: AC-2.1: curl -I confirms max-age=31536000, immutable on /assets/ paths
AC-2.2: curl -I validates presence of all 5 mandatory security headers on HTML responses
AC-2.3: curl -I on invalid paths returns HTTP 404 rather than HTTP 200 index.html
description: Run automated curl and HTTP inspection scripts against build preview and edge staging to guarantee strict security compliance and confirm soft 404 vulnerability elimination.

title: Implement Route Code-Splitting and Rollup Vendor Chunking in App.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: AC-3.1: Public marketing routes separated from heavy authenticated app via React.lazy
AC-3.2: Recharts, test playback engine, and internal app components isolated into deferred chunks
AC-3.3: Rollup manualChunks splits vendor-react, vendor-icons, and vendor-charts cleanly
AC-3.4: Suspense fallback prevents layout shift during route navigation
description: Refactor App.tsx to dynamically import private app routes and marketing subpages using React.lazy and Suspense. Configure Rollup manualChunks in vite.config.ts to isolate third-party vendor libraries.

title: Measure Marketing Bundle Size and Verify Async Route Transitions
acceptanceCriteria: AC-3.1: Initial marketing JavaScript footprint < 100 KB gzipped (< 250 KB uncompressed)
AC-3.2: Recharts bundle does not load on marketing landing routes
AC-3.3: Authenticated route navigation loads chunks smoothly without console runtime errors
description: Analyze build output chunk sizes via Rollup build report, verify chunk isolation between public and private routes, and test client navigation to ensure smooth Suspense hydration.

title: Standardize Route Metadata and Implement Static Pre-Rendering for 13 Routes
acceptanceCriteria: AC-4.1: Unified Seo component configured with distinct title, meta description, and self-referencing canonical on all 13 routes
AC-4.2: Build pipeline pre-renders static HTML for all 13 routes into dist/
AC-4.3: Raw HTML contains full semantic content, headings, and distinct canonical links
AC-4.4: Canonical cannibalization trap completely removed from raw HTML output
description: Standardize SEO metadata across all 13 public marketing routes using a unified Seo component. Create a build-time pre-rendering pipeline that outputs distinct static HTML files with pre-populated meta tags and semantic body text.

title: Verify Raw HTML Titles, Canonicals, and Semantic DOM Across 13 URLs
acceptanceCriteria: AC-4.1: Automated curl test confirms distinct title on each of the 13 raw HTML files
AC-4.2: Automated curl test confirms self-referencing canonical on each of the 13 routes
AC-4.3: Zero raw HTML files contain empty
AC-4.4: Pre-rendered HTML hydrates cleanly in browser without React hydration mismatch warnings
description: Execute crawler simulation scripts against dist/ artifacts to verify raw HTML meta tags, self-referencing canonical links, and rendered body copy before JavaScript execution.

title: Consolidate Schema.org Graph on Homepage and Implement FAQ Rich Snippets
acceptanceCriteria: AC-5.1: Duplicate JSON-LD scripts removed from index.html
AC-5.2: Single consolidated @graph schema on Homepage with verified Organization, WebSite, and SoftwareApplication
AC-5.3: Fictitious SearchAction and self-serving aggregateRating removed
AC-5.4: Verified sameAs social profiles linked in Organization entity
AC-5.5: FAQPage schema on /faq matches all 12 visible questions and answers; accordion text accessible in DOM
description: Eliminate colliding structured data in index.html, establish a single valid Schema.org graph on Home.jsx adhering to Google Rich Results guidelines, and ensure FAQPage schema matches visible DOM content.

title: Validate JSON-LD Schema Graphs and Rich Snippet Compliance
acceptanceCriteria: AC-5.1: Schema validation test confirms single @graph schema on homepage with zero syntax errors
AC-5.2: Validation confirms absence of SearchAction and aggregateRating
AC-5.3: FAQPage schema validates successfully against Google Rich Results schema definitions with all 12 Q&A pairs matching DOM
description: Run structured data linter and Google Rich Results conformance tests to ensure zero schema warnings or errors on both homepage and FAQ routes.

title: Clean Sitemap, Update Robots.txt Directives, and Add Auth Noindex Metadata
acceptanceCriteria: AC-6.1: public/sitemap.xml contains exactly the 13 canonical marketing URLs with correct priorities; auth URLs purged
AC-6.2: public/robots.txt includes explicit Disallow: /app/ directive and valid Sitemap URL
AC-6.3: Login.tsx and Signup.tsx dynamically set <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
description: Direct search crawlers exclusively to high-value marketing pages by pruning thin auth routes from sitemap.xml, disallowing private app paths in robots.txt, and setting noindex robot tags on authentication screens.

title: Validate Robots Directives, Sitemap XML Syntax, and Auth Noindex Tags
acceptanceCriteria: AC-6.1: XML schema validator verifies sitemap.xml has zero syntax errors and exactly 13 URLs
AC-6.2: Robots parser confirms /app/* is disallowed and sitemap link is reachable
AC-6.3: Headless test verifies noindex, nofollow tag present when navigating to /app/login and /app/signup
description: Execute automated XML linting and robots parser verification to confirm crawl budget isolation and shield private application screens from search engine indexation.
